fix: harden PDF embed pipeline against token-limit failures

- _estimate_tokens: use len/3 instead of len/4 for char-based estimate;
  technical content (hex tables, register maps, TOC dot leaders) tokenises
  at ~3 chars/token, keeping chunks safely under nomic-embed-text's 2048-
  token context limit with max_tokens: 800
- upsert_chunks: upsert one point at a time inside per-chunk try/except so
  a single oversized or failed chunk no longer aborts the entire document
- install-test-guide: add explicit AGENT PAUSE block after carta init
  instructing the agent to tell the user to restart Claude Code before
  continuing; fix Step 4 scan-results snippet to use correct field names
  (doc/detail); add first-run note explaining empty changed_since_last_audit
- Close todos: fix-estimate-tokens and add-per-chunk-error-handling

fix: replace fragile grep YAML parser in hooks with python3 yaml.safe_load

Root cause: Both hook scripts used `grep -A1 'key' | grep -q 'true'` to read
nested YAML config values. This pipeline false-positives on any adjacent key
with value true, and fails if YAML nesting places the boolean beyond one line.
Fixed by using python3 yaml.safe_load to access the correct nested key path
directly, with a fail-closed fallback on parse error.

fix: exempt anchor_doc from homeless_doc scanner check

anchor_doc (and anchor_docs list) entries in carta config are legitimate

release: fix skill cache versioning, token estimation, chunk error handling — v0.1.8

- carta init now removes stale version dirs from plugin cache before writing
  new version, preventing old skills from loading after upgrade (bootstrap.py)
- _estimate_tokens uses max(word_count*1.3, char_count/4) to avoid
  underestimating punctuation-heavy content like PDF TOC dot leaders (parse.py)
- upsert_chunks wraps per-chunk embedding in try/except so a single oversized
  or malformed chunk no longer discards all other good chunks (embed.py)

fix: pre-release hardening — resolve all 37 audit issues

Comprehensive audit of the codebase identified and fixed 37 issues
across critical, high, medium, and low severity categories. Details
documented in docs/testing/AUDIT_TRACKER.md.

Critical (5):
- Replace pypdf with pymupdf in pyproject.toml (fitz was already imported)
- Fix uvx command in README (entry point is carta, not carta-cc)
- Fix curl install URL path in README
- Fix carta-init skill to call carta init before .carta/ exists
- Add CI test workflow so regressions can't ship to PyPI

High (5):
- Eliminate shell injection in hook scripts (path via sys.argv, not interpolation)
- Catch ConfigError/KeyError/RuntimeError at CLI top level
- Warn and skip (not silently overwrite) existing Claude Code hooks
- Verify hook format against Claude Code schema; handle malformed JSON
- Fix README config example (remove embed.enabled, add qdrant_url)

Medium (15):
- Ollama URL now reads CARTA_OLLAMA_URL env var instead of being hardcoded
- Vector dimension derived from model config, not hardcoded 768
- Check Qdrant HTTP response status; distinguish 409 from real errors
- Guard shutil.rmtree against symlinks (use unlink instead)
- Use copy.deepcopy in _deep_merge to prevent DEFAULTS mutation
- Add type validation on config after merge
- Add module-enabled guards to cmd_embed and cmd_scan
- Walk parent directories in find_config (like git does)
- Replace python3/pyyaml in hooks with pure-shell grep
- Use git rev-parse wrapper for hook paths (portable, CWD-drift immune)
- Wrap settings.json parse in try/except for malformed JSON
- Fix config.yaml.example comment (wrong filename)
- Update plugin.json version to match pyproject.toml
- Remove broken docs/superpowers/specs/ reference from README
- Fix doc-embed skill sidecar schema to match actual field names

Low (12):
- Add install/ and *.egg-info to copytree ignore list
- Extend .gitignore to cover .carta/carta/ and .carta/hooks/
- Idempotency check uses line-by-line comparison (not substring)
- Empty project name falls back to carta-project
- Raise setuptools lower bound to >=61.0 (PEP 621 requires it)
- Dynamic version from carta.__version__ (single source of truth)
- Add [project.optional-dependencies] dev = ["pytest>=7.0"]
- Add shared conftest.py with canonical minimal_cfg fixtures
- File I/O uses explicit encoding="utf-8" throughout
- Remove dead variables and fix pip check in install.sh
- Stabilise CLI subprocess tests across cwd
- Expand bootstrap test coverage (copytree patterns, qdrant env, hooks)
